title: Suspended Animation (film)

text.lead: Suspended Animation is a 2001 American thriller film directed and produced by John D. Hancock and starring Alex McArthur.
text.cast:
- Alex McArthur as Tom Kempton
- Laura Esterman as Vanessa Boulette
- Sage Allen as Ann Boulette
- Maria Cina as Clara Hansen
- Rebecca Harrell as Hilary Kempton
- Fred Meyers as Sandor Hansen
text.reception: The film received mixed reviews from critics. On the review aggregator website Rotten Tomatoes, the film has a 52% approval rating, based on 25 reviews. The website's consensus reads, " Suspended Animation offers some gory good fun for genre fans, even if the end results don't quite transcend their cheerfully shallow roots."
